name: Adachi Miori
source:
A beautiful girl with a serious personality with a mature appearance and dignified behavior.
Coming from an upper-class background and having been educated to be above all else. Although strict about hierarchy, she does not arrogantly disrespect others.
Miori is popular for her willingness to take charge and ability to lead others.
The protagonist sees her as a dangerous enemy with a strong will,  but one he plans on taking down.
